title: Maximal Prikry Sequences
summary: In this paper we investigate the covering machinery of the Jensen-Steel core model $K$, under the hypothesis that there is no inner model with a Woodin cardinal. In an earlier work, Mitchell and the first author showed that if $ν>ω_2$ is a regular cardinal in $K$ but a singular ordinal in $V$, then $ν$ is a measurable cardinal in $K$. In this article, we further show that under certain circumstances, there exists a maximal Prikry sequence $C$ for a measure on $ν$ in $K$.
